leave_parental_paid_009.evidence: Paid parental leave is a benefit that provides paid leave for an eligible employee to bond with his or her newborn, adopted child, or foster child. ... A parental leave of absence for up to thirty (30) workdays shall be granted upon request for the purpose of childbearing and/or child rearing.

leave_pregnancy_disability_010.evidence: any portion of an educator's absence from work because of a medical disability connected with or resulting from her pregnancy may be charged to her available sick leave.
